newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: SQUASH-JANSHER BEATS EYLES TO CLAIM EIGHTH WORLD OPEN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-JANSHER BEATS EYLES TO CLAIM EIGHTH WORLD OPEN TITLE.

text.p: Jansher Khan, the top-seeded defending champion, won his eighth World Open squash title on Friday, beating second seed Rodney Eyles of Australia 15-13 17-15 11-15 15-3.

The win takes Jansher one step closer to his ambition of winning 10 World Open titles and six British Open championships to reverse the record of his great Pakistani predecessor Jahangir Khan, who won the World title six times and the British event 10 times.
"Actually I think I can win 11 or 12 World Opens if I play to about 32 as I plan to," said Jansher.
Jansher, 27, was never at his best in winning in 71 minutes.
"I did not play as well today as I did earlier in the tournament. I think playing in front of my home crowd with the world title at stake made me more nervous than usual," he said.
